text:
Lena: Tiny but annoying: on narrow screens the table header's sticky shadow sometimes overlaps the row content when the header collapses on scroll. Happens on iOS Safari and Android Chrome. Short clip: https://imgur.com/ijkl9012.mp4
Omar: repro on Moto G7. Sequence: open Console > Devices tab > scroll down fast > header sticks then flickers > sometimes covers first line of row. Looks like our z-index + translateZ trick is misfiring.
Priya: UX suggestion: reduce header elevation and add 6px top padding to the table body when sticky to avoid visual overlap. Also prefer transition: transform 120ms for header so it doesn't jump.
Sam: dev note: header uses will-change: transform and we apply transform: translateY to stick. On some mobile GPUs this creates rendering glitches. Alternative: use position: sticky + top: 0 without translate and rely on box-shadow for elevation.
Lena: copy nits: change "Last seen" -> "Last active" for devices table on mobile so it reads cleaner in narrow columns. Also shorten the status pill text to "Act." for very small widths.
design-bot: new figma update with sticky header padding and updated copy: https://figma.com/file/DEF/table-header-mobile-fix :white_check_mark:
qa-bot: added flaky test to mobile-sticky-header suite. Current fail rate: 4/10 on older iOS WebView. Ticket RD-3582.
Omar: propose patch: .table--sticky-header { position: sticky; top: 0; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.06); padding-top: 6px; } and add JS fallback to toggle .stuck class when intersection observer detects header stuck.
Priya: let's also ensure we don't shift focus when header becomes sticky; only visual change. And update aria-labels for the columns so screen readers announce after the sticky state.
Sam: will send small PR with visual regression screenshots. Will test on devices lab and add cf-workers preview.
Lena: assigning QA and design review. Hope this stops the flicker. Thanks folks.
